answer: Before the stamp comes a toll of 61 credits, collected in coin before the name is written down, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. A name gets on the books only through Audited tinker toll seal, because a seal tinkers renew after pot hearings. The clerk notes walnut. The tally keeps ledge. The summit is on the docket.
